title: Staying Present
description: Five teachings on the small, constant act of leaving the present — and what it takes to stay.
welcome: You're here because the technique isn't the problem anymore. You can concentrate, you can soften, you can watch the breath — and still, by noon, the old pattern is running you. This course is about what that pattern actually is: the small, constant act of leaving the moment you're in — and what it takes to stop.
